verdict.comment: The vote goes to KITARO KICH who appeared to score with plenty in hand at Chelmsford recently and can make light of his 5lb penalty.

comments.ashfordhill: 1lb higher than for her win over C&D in November, but has been done no favours by the draw
comments.globalwarning: 2lb lower than for his win over C&D in September; below form lately and drawn wide
comments.kitarokich: Won two of last three starts and won in fine style last time; 5lb penalty may not stop him
comments.kondratievwave: Just beaten by Split Elevens at Kempton last time; 1lb better off; shouldn't be far away
comments.landlover: Has gone backwards from a promising stable debut; 1-26 and enough to prove back up in trip
comments.portoro: Running consistently well at Southwell lately, but has won on Polytrack; hard to rule out
comments.rabinal: Has become inconsistent, but is 6lb lower than when winning this race last year
comments.runaroundsioux: 1-13 but ran well when second over 8.6f at Wolverhampton recently; 7f may suit her better
comments.shotoflove: 8lb below last winning mark and shaped as though the return to 7f would suit last time
comments.splitelevens: Has won six of his last 12 starts including two over C&D; should go well again.
comments.triggered: Losing run up to 15 despite a sliding mark; outside stall no help in bid for a resurgence
comments.twitch: Dual winner at Chelmsford last year, but has no great record after a break of this length

races.raceComment: kondratievwave is marginally preferred with a score of 62.3%. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on polytrack, particularly in sprints

verdict.comment: Preference is for CITY CYCLONE. who won twice over 7f last month and looks interesting on this step back up in trip.

comments.citycyclone: Two 7f Tapeta wins in January; held at 6f last twice but he's in the mix back up in trip
comments.erniesvalentine: Made it 5-21 on AW when scoring off reduced mark at Lingfield; respected on stable debut
comments.fatgladiator: His win came off this mark over C&D but he returns after a long absence; best watched
comments.lessay: 0-14 since debut win but he's in fair form and has claims if he can find something extra
comments.revolutionise: Eight-time AW winner but he's been quiet recently and needs to rediscover his spark
comments.soarabove: Course specialist but last win was in 2022 and he's struggled this winter
comments.starshiba: Won over 1m at Lingfield in December but he's not posed a threat in three runs since
comments.tronido: Dual AW winner but she's lost her way in last two runs and needs to get back on track

races.raceComment: tronido is marginally preferred with a score of 55.9%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over citycyclone. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on polytrack, particularly in sprints

verdict.comment: Several have possibilities but the vote goes to the lightly raced 4yo PORT ROAD, who didn't get any luck over C&D last time.

comments.alameen: On dangerous mark but last win was in October 2023 and he needs precision timing
comments.benybryn: Went close at Chelmsford in his second run after a long absence; respected back up in trip
comments.dakotapower: Two turf wins last summer but he struggled on return last month and is now 1-12 on AW
comments.enpassant: Won over C&D last month and didn't get the best of runs at Chelmsford latest; respected
comments.portroad: Eyecatcher over C&D last month and he still has potential after only seven runs; dangerous
comments.royaljet: Still lightly raced and mark is tumbling but he has lots to prove
comments.teasea: Three wins this winter and he ran well again when fourth on Tapeta latest; shortlisted
comments.vincelombardi: Went close on Polytrack in two of his last three runs last year; respected on stable debut

races.raceComment: enpassant is marginally preferred with a score of 56.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more reliable profile over teasea. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for PATCH'S BOND, who went very close on his handicap debut at Lingfield and is open to more progress back in trip.

comments.arctician: Four-time course winner but was down the field last time and he's never won at this trip
comments.cavalrycall: Sole win (13 starts) was on turf and was disappointing at Lingfield latest; down the list
comments.dingle: On dangerous mark but last win was 14 months ago and he needs to rediscover his spark
comments.foreseen: Struggled in last two runs and has something to prove for new yard; equipment off
comments.gaietymusical: Started this year with three wins but was vulnerable last time and has tough draw here
comments.gunlock: Has struggled in his three handicaps and has plenty to prove for new yard; equipment on
comments.hesgotgame: Lightly raced 4yo but was disappointing last time and has a bit to prove on his comeback
comments.joyceanway: Unexposed 4yo but was tailed off on handicap/stable debut in January; lots to prove
comments.morethanafeelin: Won three AW handicaps since July and had excuse in tactical race last time; in the mix
comments.mrbaloo: Dual course winner who won at Southwell latest and he remains feasibly treated; key player
comments.patchsbond: Went close on handicap debut at Lingfield and he's open to more progress back in trip
comments.porterin: Triple AW winner but he faded last time and now goes back up in grade; has work to do
comments.rhythmnrock: Has lost his way since his second over C&D last May and is now 0-16 in handicaps
comments.tadreeb: Won his first three for new yard but was held last time and is 0-10 at this trip

races.raceComment: mrbaloo is marginally preferred with a score of 56.4%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive over morethanafeelin. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
